fusions.name: Shaken Droplets
fusions.desc: Shakes the water off your back at a target for 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Upended Wash
fusions.desc: Tips your bulk forward and throws a wash over a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage, knocking everything in it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Oiled Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to its source instead, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Raft at Rest

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross ground
and you mend faster while you float on it
and blows slide off you while you are on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While on it, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 6%.
